tw.$description: Semantic aliases for the desktop app: Tailwind v4 @theme keys, including every semantic slot stock shadcn/ui components resolve. Nothing here holds a value — every token is a pure alias onto a core token, which is what keeps this a mapping table and not a second palette. Add a slot here rather than overriding a shadcn component.

color-popover.$description: shadcn `popover`. Popovers sit on --elevated, the same surface as fields and chips.

color-primary.$description: shadcn `primary`. Follows [data-accent], so a stock <Button> re-tints with the user's accent for free.

color-primary-foreground.$description: shadcn `primary-foreground`. Not always white — teal/green/amber use dark ink in dark theme.

color-secondary.$description: shadcn `secondary`. shadcn's secondary button is borderless, so it maps to --raised (v1's .btn--secondary:hover and .seg button.on) rather than to the bordered --elevated.

color-muted.$description: shadcn `muted`. The inset surface v1 uses for fields, chips, kbd and count badges.

color-accent.$description: shadcn `accent` is the neutral hover/active surface for menu and list items, NOT the brand colour — that is `primary`. Mapping it to --hover keeps it aligned with the Material 3 state layer on Android.

color-destructive-foreground.$description: shadcn `destructive-foreground`. See tokens/color/static.json — v1 had no solid danger fill, so this ink is an addition.

color-input.$description: shadcn `input` is the field's border colour, not its fill; the fill is `muted`/`background`.

color-ring.$description: shadcn `ring` — the focus ring. §4 requires the ring is never removed.

color-sidebar-foreground.$description: shadcn `sidebar-foreground`. Sidebar items rest dim and go --text on hover.

color-sidebar-accent.$description: shadcn `sidebar-accent` is the ACTIVE nav item, which in v1 (.sb__item.on) is the accent-tinted --selected — unlike the plain menu hover above.

color-sidebar-border.$description: shadcn `sidebar-border`. The sidebar separates with a divider, not a control border.

color-chart-1.$description: shadcn `chart-1`. The chart ramp reuses the content-kind hues so a sync/storage chart is legible next to the list it describes.

color-brand.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. An unambiguous name for the brand accent, because shadcn has already spent the word `accent` on its hover surface. `bg-brand` and `bg-primary` are the same colour; prefer `brand` outside shadcn components.

color-brand-2.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. The accent ramp's light step, for emphasis text on dark (SAS digits).

color-selected.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. The accent-tinted list-row selection fill (.row.sel). Exposed so it is a utility rather than an inline style.

color-pressed.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. The neutral pressed state layer.

radius.$description: shadcn's base radius variable. 8px — v1's control radius.

radius-sm.$description: Overriding Tailwind's radius ramp is expected by shadcn, which derives all four steps from --radius.

radius-md.$description: `rounded-md` — the default on shadcn Button and Input. 8px, matching v1's .btn.

radius-xl.$description: `rounded-xl` — the default on shadcn Card. 13px, matching v1's .card.

ease-cp.$description: Tailwind `ease-cp`. The single CopyPaste easing curve.
